name: CodeablePress: Simple Frontend Profile Picture Upload
author: codeablepress

sections.description:
⚠️ This plugin has been retired.

We’ve rebuilt this plugin from the ground up as a brand new, modern WordPress.org plugin:

👉 ChargeWP – Front-End Avatar Upload

Please install and activate the new plugin to continue receiving updates and support.

This version (1.0.1) now displays a migration notice and version 1.0.2 will not run the upload functionality anymore — it’s safe to keep active temporarily while switching.

Why the Change?

  • The new plugin offers improved performance and security
  • Better WooCommerce and new block editor support
  • Ongoing updates and future enhancements on WordPress.org
  • Easier support and automatic updates

What Happens After Updating?

After updating to version 1.0.1, you’ll see a notice in your WordPress Dashboard with a one-click option to Install & Activate ChargeWP – Front-End Avatar Upload.
All existing data (user profile pictures) remain after switching plugins but will not work if you go back to the old plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin still supported?

No. Please migrate to ChargeWP – Front-End Avatar Upload for continued updates and support.

Will my existing user avatars or uploads be lost?

No. This retirement release does not delete or modify any existing user data. The new plugin will convert existing data over automatically.

Can I safely deactivate or delete this plugin after migration?

Yes. Once you’ve installed and activated the new plugin, you can safely remove this one.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Security: Enhanced security by implementing “Late Escaping” on all administrative URLs and action links.
  • Security: Improved data handling for security nonces by adding unslashing and sanitization during verification.
  • Hardening: Updated admin notices and plugin row messages to ensure all dynamic content is properly escaped before output.
  • Fix: Standardized internal URL helpers to comply with WordPress.org coding standards.

1.0.1

  • Soft Retirement release.
  • Added in-dashboard and plugin screen notices to guide users to the new plugin.
  • Added one-click Install & Activate migration flow.
  • Removed all previous upload functionality once new plugin is installed.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release – Frontend avatar upload from WooCommerce My Account or shortcode.

short_description: A simple, lightweight, and secure way for users to upload profile pictures directly from the WooCommerce My Account page or via shortcode.
